component.name: OpenDeviceHub
component.summary: Configure Keychron keyboards and graphics card lighting

description.p: Configure Keychron keyboards that run Keychron's open source ZMK firmware, and the lighting of Gigabyte graphics cards, without a browser or a background service. OpenDeviceHub talks to each device directly.

ul.li: Keychron V3 Ultra 8K (ANSI, ISO, JIS) over USB or the Ultra-Link 8K 2.4 GHz receiver
Remap every key and the knob on each layer: keys with modifiers, media and mouse keys, layers, lighting and Keychron keys
Lighting effect, brightness, speed and colour
Polling rate (USB and 2.4 GHz), debounce and the idle and sleep timers
Gigabyte graphics cards with RGB Fusion 2 lighting: mode, brightness, speed and a colour per zone

description.p: Keychron keyboards need a udev rule for /dev/hidraw access, graphics cards access to /dev/i2c-*; see the project page.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Keychron or Gigabyte.
